title: Advanced Physics Expansion — Wave 003
epistemic_rule: These are external mathematics/physics structures or archive extrapolations selected because they sharpen existing Timic questions. They are not retroactive claims that Tim originally derived these theories.

clusters.timic_question: If Axis is a generator of transformation, what is invariant under its flow?

physics.name: Killing symmetry
physics.meaning: ξ generates an isometry of the metric.

physics.name: Noether theorem
physics.meaning: continuous variational symmetries generate conserved currents.

physics.name: fixed point
physics.meaning: Still Center can be represented as a fixed point of a flow.

physics.name: linear stability
physics.meaning: eigenvalues determine local attraction, repulsion or spiral behavior.

clusters.extrapolation: A mature Axis theory should carry an invariant registry: which quantities remain unchanged under each Axis transformation on each layer.

clusters.timic_question: How can a system return geometrically while retaining history?

physics.name: Wilson loop
physics.meaning: A connection can accumulate nontrivial holonomy around a closed path.

physics.name: Berry phase
physics.meaning: adiabatic transport in parameter space can produce measurable geometric phase.

physics.name: Chern number
physics.meaning: global integer invariant built from curvature in appropriate systems.

clusters.extrapolation: Timic Return should be split into endpoint-return, state-return, phase-return, topological-return and narrative-return. These need not coincide.

clusters.timic_question: Can local dynamics encode global structure?

physics.name: Dirac index
physics.equation: index(D)=dim ker D_+ - dim ker D_-
physics.meaning: analytical zero-mode data is tied to global topological invariants through index theorems.

physics.name: Dirac operator
physics.meaning: first-order geometric differential operator on spinors.

clusters.extrapolation: This is a rigorous external model for local↔global coupling. Future Potato Dynamics work can ask whether any project observable is a genuine global invariant rather than using 'integration' only rhetorically.

clusters.timic_question: Can path and relation be primary even when local metric details are secondary?

physics.name: Chern-Simons action
physics.meaning: topological gauge action central to knot/link observables and anyonic physics.

physics.name: braid representation
physics.meaning: braid histories can act nontrivially on a state space.

clusters.extrapolation: Door/Spiral research should distinguish geometric crossing from topological braiding: two trajectories can share endpoints but belong to distinct braid or homotopy classes.

clusters.timic_question: Can one entity have different valid representations depending on interaction versus propagation?

physics.name: CKM mixing
physics.meaning: weak-interaction quark states are related to mass eigenstates by a unitary mixing matrix.

physics.name: PMNS mixing
physics.meaning: flavor neutrino states are superpositions of mass eigenstates.

physics.name: oscillation phase
physics.meaning: relative phase accumulation produces oscillation probabilities.

clusters.extrapolation: Mirror/Twin research can use basis transformation as a disciplined analogy: different representations need not imply different underlying systems, but the transformation matrix must be defined.

clusters.timic_question: What precise mathematical families contain forward and backward evolution?

physics.name: retarded/advanced Green functions
physics.meaning: solutions selected by causal boundary conditions.

physics.name: Wheeler-Feynman absorber theory
physics.meaning: time-symmetric direct-action electrodynamics using advanced and retarded structure under absorber conditions.

physics.name: Two-State Vector Formalism
physics.meaning: pre- and post-selected quantum description with forward/backward evolving states.

physics.name: Schwinger-Keldysh
physics.meaning: closed-time-path contour for non-equilibrium/open quantum expectation values.

clusters.extrapolation: Before mapping Red/Blue to any of these, recover Tim's original directional assignment and determine whether it referred to causality, memory/anticipation, polarity, or symbolic time.

clusters.timic_question: What would make 11D Potato more than dimensional symbolism?

physics.name: 11D supergravity field strength
physics.meaning: four-form field strength from three-form gauge potential.

physics.name: 11D action schematic
physics.meaning: gravity plus form-field dynamics and Chern-Simons term.

physics.name: M2/M5 sectors
physics.meaning: dynamical extended objects in M-theory.

physics.name: Basu-Harvey schematic
physics.meaning: brane-intersection/funnel equation in certain M2/M5 constructions; conventions vary.

clusters.extrapolation: A physical 11D Timic model would need a manifold, signature, fields, compactification geometry, fluxes, effective 4D theory and observables.

clusters.timic_question: What real stellar physics joins source, Axis, rotation, outward flow, spiral and polarity?

physics.name: Parker spiral
physics.meaning: solar rotation winds the heliospheric magnetic field carried by outward solar wind.

physics.name: Parker-Yoshimura rule
physics.meaning: direction of dynamo-wave propagation in mean-field αΩ dynamo models.

physics.name: equatorward sign condition
physics.equation: α∂Ω/∂r<0 under common simplified northern-hemisphere assumptions
physics.meaning: one standard sign condition for equatorward migration.

clusters.extrapolation: Sun/Spiral and counter-rotation material should add an MHD subbranch covering toroidal/poloidal field conversion, magnetic helicity, differential rotation and polarity reversal.

clusters.timic_question: How should North/Sirius/precession language be reconstructed astronomically?

physics.name: Sirius binary
facts: Sirius A is the brightest star in the night sky
Sirius B is a white dwarf companion

physics.name: axial precession
physics.fact: Earth's axial precession period is roughly 25.8 kyr.

clusters.extrapolation: Build a celestial-coordinate audit for every project star/pole claim: right ascension, declination, epoch, proper motion, observer latitude, azimuth/altitude and historical date.

clusters.timic_question: Which kinds of recurrence genuinely mean 'return at another level'?

physics.name: RG limit cycle
physics.meaning: recurrence in logarithmic scale; important in Efimov physics.

physics.name: reaction-diffusion
physics.meaning: nonlinear local interactions can generate rotating spiral waves.

physics.name: spiral-density pattern
physics.meaning: persistent galactic pattern can differ from the material constituents passing through it.

clusters.extrapolation: The archive should classify every Spiral claim by domain: geometric, temporal, state-space, scale-space, biological, wave-pattern, social or symbolic.
